mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 49 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a third quarter moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona wants to remind you that alternate-side parking rules begin November 20, meaning you must park on specific sides of the street based on the calendar date through April 1. Additionally, the Senior Center will be closed for Thanksgiving on November 26 and 27.
There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music at Bailey's Run today and more live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly report, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds on October 23 who were riding prohibited eMotos after previously being warned, resulting in citations for their parents.
You can look forward to the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough today. Please note that Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM.
